About KPMG Norway
-----------------

KPMG er mest kjent som revisorer, forretningskonsulenter og advokater, men vi er også mye mer.  
Vi vet hva virksomheter har på toppen av sin agenda, derfor har vi bygget ledende fagmiljøer innen områdene som blir viktigst i framtiden: cybersikkerhet, bærekraft, kompetanse og teknologi.  
Fordi våre råd skal lønne seg, og de skal være tilpasset morgendagen, både for kundene våre og for samfunnet.  
Da gjelder det å ligge i forkant.  
Å ligge i forkant er lønnsomt. Det er for eksempel bedre å sikre seg mot cyberangrep enn å rydde opp i etterkant. Vi vet, fordi vi hjelper til både før, under og etter kriser.  
  
Vi vet også at de selskapene som investerer i framtidens teknologi og lykkes med det grønne skiftet, ikke bare er med på å redde klimaet, de er også med på å skape morgendagens arbeidsplasser.  
I KPMG våger vi å stille spørsmål, utfordre, vise nysgjerrighet og si ting rett frem. Kun da forstår vi kundenes utfordringer og muligheter fullt ut, og slik blir vi i stand til å gi bedre råd. Råd som ser mot fremtiden.  
  
Fordi på sikt er det det som lønner seg.

About Jean-Philippe Syda

Jean-Philippe Syda currently serves as the Responsable Achats/Approvisionnements & Ventes Coproduits at Jungbunzlauer, where he plays a pivotal role in shaping the procurement strategy within the chemical industry. With a multidisciplinary background in law, economics, and management, complemented by a specialization in international purchasing, Jean-Philippe brings over 14 years of extensive experience in industrial environments, particularly in the chemical and metallurgy sectors. His expertise lies in sourcing, negotiating, and establishing framework contracts that optimize supply chain efficiency and drive cost savings.  
  
As a member of the Comité de Direction, Jean-Philippe was instrumental in the creation of the procurement department, demonstrating his strategic vision and leadership capabilities. He manages a dedicated team of four professionals, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement in procurement processes. His role encompasses not only the management of purchasing operations but also the sales of co-products, where he leverages his deep understanding of international commerce and negotiation tactics.  
  
In addition to his professional responsibilities, Jean-Philippe is committed to nurturing the next generation of professionals in the field. He serves as a mentor for students pursuing BTS in Assistant Management, International Commerce, and Negotiation, as well as those in DUT GEA and Licence AES programs. His proficiency in ISO standards, logistics chain management, and digitalization of client relations further enhances his contributions to Jungbunzlauer, positioning the company as a leader in sustainable and efficient procurement practices. Through his strategic initiatives and commitment to excellence, Jean-Philippe Syda continues to drive value and innovation within the organization.

About Great Streets Akron
-------------------------

Great Streets Akron is an initiative aimed at improving the neighborhood business districts (NBDs) in the City of Akron, with a goal of greater community engagement, increased business development, promoting safer neighborhoods, improving aesthetics, urban design, & public space, and improving transportation conditions. By targeting city support and resources in our Great Streets districts, we create a notable impact.  
  
The concept of Placemaking is the key approach to planning and urban design driving our initiative. Placemaking capitalizes on a local community's assets, inspiration, and potential, with the intention of creating public spaces that promote people's health, happiness, and well-being. Over the last few years, Akron has adopted several initiatives, Great Streets being one, to improve public spaces, encourage private investment, and support talent retention and attraction in the area.  
  
The City of Akron seeks to enhance, grow, and connect our business districts while empowering the unique, local culture that makes them the “hubs” of our neighborhoods.

About EMIT Imaging
------------------

Emit Imaging develops tools and applications that bridge the gap between in vivo imaging and pathology. Our technology acquires high-resolution, high-sensitivity fluorescence imaging combined with a whole-body anatomical image in a comprehensive 3D data set. This technology can dramatically increase the value of each sample in a multi-modal study.  
Our flagship system, Xerra, is used by pharma, biotech, and academic labs globally to study:  
1\. Drug pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics  
2\. Phenotyping and model development  
3\. Biodistribution  
4\. Gene/Protein Expression  
5\. Cell tracking  
  
Emit Imaging offers instrumentation and research services.

What types of imaging solutions does Emit Imaging provide?

Emit Imaging specializes in advanced imaging solutions that integrate high-resolution fluorescence imaging with anatomical imaging. Our primary offerings include cryo-fluorescence tomography and molecular tissue imaging, which allow researchers to visualize biological processes at the cellular and molecular levels. These technologies are particularly beneficial in fields such as oncology, drug discovery, and gene therapy.

How does Emit Imaging support drug discovery and development?

Emit Imaging provides tools that enhance the drug discovery process by enabling researchers to visualize the effects of therapeutic agents in real-time. Our imaging solutions allow for the assessment of drug efficacy and toxicity at the molecular level, facilitating a better understanding of how drugs interact with biological tissues. This capability is crucial for optimizing drug candidates and accelerating the development timeline.

In which industries can Emit Imaging's technologies be applied?

Our technologies are applicable across various industries, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and academic research. Specifically, Emit Imaging's solutions are utilized in oncology for cancer research, in gene therapy for tracking therapeutic delivery, and in digital histology for automated tissue imaging analysis. This versatility makes our tools valuable for a wide range of scientific inquiries.

What is the significance of combining fluorescence imaging with anatomical imaging?

Combining fluorescence imaging with anatomical imaging provides a comprehensive view of biological tissues. Fluorescence imaging allows for the visualization of specific molecular targets, while anatomical imaging offers context regarding tissue structure. This integration enhances the ability to correlate molecular events with anatomical features, leading to deeper insights in research areas such as cancer biology and therapeutic development.

Can Emit Imaging's solutions be used for automated tissue imaging?

Yes, Emit Imaging offers automated tissue imaging solutions that streamline the analysis of biological samples. Our technology enables high-throughput imaging and quantification of tissue samples, which is essential for large-scale studies and clinical applications. This automation reduces the potential for human error and increases efficiency in data collection and analysis.

What support does Emit Imaging provide for researchers using their imaging tools?

Emit Imaging is committed to supporting researchers through comprehensive training and technical assistance. We provide resources such as user manuals, online tutorials, and personalized training sessions to ensure that users can effectively utilize our imaging technologies. Additionally, our technical support team is available to address any questions or challenges that may arise during the research process.

About Lloyd Staffing
--------------------

The hiring challenge that businesses face when it comes to recruiting is the lack of time, technology, tools, or bandwidth to identify the right talent for an open position. The risks of passing on qualified impact candidates and wasting time interviewing the wrong candidates lengthens the time to hire, costing the company significantly.  
  
Here is what every hiring manager should know when filling a position:  
1\. What is the cost of the open role to the organization?  
2\. How to communicate the WHY of your organization, so that top talent would consider exploring the option to work with you  
3\. Have an interview and hiring roadmap in place so that you present the job consistently to all candidates to keep them engaged and interested  
4\. Know what job flexibility is required to fill the open position and when contract or direct hire is the best solution  
  
Consistent reinforcement of these four activities will maximize hiring so that you and your team will see measurable results.  
  
Lloyd Staffing partners with companies to help fill critical positions so companies can get back to business! Whether you need flexible contract/temporary talent or a direct hire – our innovation, systems and interview expertise takes the burden off of you.  
  
If your organization is challenged with time and bandwidth to fill pivotal roles, let’s have a conversation. Whether or not we decide to work together, we will share hiring and interviewing insights that can have a significant impact on your business and talent outcomes.  
  
  
We are all about the smartest, most cost-effective solution to talent acquisition and workforce management.

About Intracoastal Bank
-----------------------

Intracoastal Bank was conceived by a group of Flagler County business people who had the vision to establish a truly local “hometown community bank."​ Flagler County is located along the Atlantic coast between Daytona Beach and Jacksonville in Northeast Florida. The Bank’s office, at 1290 Palm Coast Parkway NW in Palm Coast, FL, opened in June 2008.  
  
Intracoastal Bank’s shareholders consist of a diverse group of about 100 local business leaders and citizens. The Bank is led by a distinguished board of directors, including Bruce E. Page, President and Chief Executive Officer. The Bank’s professional staff and Board of Directors, most of which are Flagler County residents, have a long history and tradition in community banking.  
  
The bank has a strategic plan to remain small so that we can provide the quality service that we are known for. As a Subchapter S Bank, we are committed to being a part of our community for many years to come. Our mission is to grow slowly and steadily. The bank’s strategic plan is not to grow rapidly and sell to another financial institution.  
  
Intracoastal Bank offers the products and services that a large bank offers with the personal and friendly touch that only a true hometown bank can offer. We have the best technology available which allows the bank to customize our products and services to meet the needs of our corporate and retail customers.

### Frequently Asked Questions about AIRTAG

What types of mobile shopping solutions does AIRTAG offer?

AIRTAG specializes in a variety of mobile shopping solutions, including secure NFC mobile applications, mobile marketing, e-commerce platforms, and integration services. Our offerings also encompass mobile wallets, digital wallets, mobile ordering and payment systems, as well as mobile loyalty and couponing solutions. These services are designed to enhance the shopping experience for consumers while providing businesses with effective tools to engage with their customers.

How does AIRTAG ensure the security of its mobile applications?

Security is a top priority for AIRTAG. We implement advanced security measures, including encryption protocols and secure NFC technology, to protect user data and transactions. Our applications are regularly tested for vulnerabilities, and we adhere to industry standards to ensure compliance with data protection regulations. Additionally, our partnership with IDEMIA, a leader in identity and security solutions, reinforces our commitment to providing secure mobile shopping experiences.

Which industries can benefit from AIRTAG's mobile shopping solutions?

AIRTAG's mobile shopping solutions are versatile and can benefit a wide range of industries, including retail, hospitality, food and beverage, and e-commerce. Businesses in these sectors can leverage our technology to enhance customer engagement, streamline payment processes, and implement loyalty programs. Our solutions are designed to meet the unique needs of each industry, helping businesses improve their operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Can AIRTAG's solutions be integrated with existing systems?

Yes, AIRTAG's solutions are designed with integration in mind. We offer integration services that allow our mobile applications to seamlessly connect with existing systems, such as point-of-sale (POS) systems, inventory management software, and customer relationship management (CRM) tools. This flexibility ensures that businesses can enhance their mobile shopping capabilities without overhauling their current infrastructure.

What are the benefits of using AIRTAG's mobile loyalty and couponing solutions?

AIRTAG's mobile loyalty and couponing solutions provide numerous benefits for businesses and consumers alike. For businesses, these solutions help increase customer retention, drive repeat purchases, and enhance customer engagement through personalized offers. For consumers, mobile loyalty programs offer convenience and instant access to rewards and discounts, making the shopping experience more enjoyable. Additionally, our solutions provide valuable data insights that help businesses tailor their marketing strategies effectively.

How can I get started with AIRTAG's services?

Getting started with AIRTAG's services is simple. Interested businesses can visit our website at http://www.airtag.com to learn more about our offerings and request a demo. Our team will work with you to understand your specific needs and develop a customized solution that aligns with your business goals. We also provide ongoing support to ensure a smooth implementation and help you maximize the benefits of our mobile shopping solutions.

About BulkyPix
--------------

BulkyPix was founded in 2008 by former Vivendi Games senior execs. It develops and publishes video games and apps for all digital platforms, ranging from mobile, social networks, PC/Mac down to connected objects, in France and worldwide.  
  
With over 200 titles published so far and 100 million downloads, BulkyPix is one of the leading independent publishers in Europe.  
  
Based on its expertise, BulkyPix helps commercial brands, companies and entertainment IPs by conceiving, developing and promoting games and playful digital experiences (serious games, advergames, transmedia projects for audiovisual properties) along with virtual reality experiences (Oculus, Cardboard).  
  
So far, BulkyPix delivered more than a hundred projects for its clients, in sectors as diverse as Energy (EDF, Veolia), Banking/Insurance (BNP Paribas, Swiss Life, Axa), FMCG (Coca-Cola, Père Dodu), Luxury (Breitling, Krug, Chanel, Pierre Fabre), Media/Entertainment (France Télévisions, Arte, Spotify, Au-Feminin, Adventure Line Production, Marathon Media, Gaumont animation), Publishing (Larousse, Hachette), Museums (Le Louvre, La Cité des Sciences) Institutions (La Marine Nationale, la Fondation Charles de Gaulle), Licenses (Astérix, Fort Boyard, Maya the Bee, Questions pour un Champion, Calimero).

nemlig.com vil skabe en nemmere hverdag og et bedre liv for danskerne, og som landets førende onlinesupermarked leverer vi hver dag tusindvis af dagligvarer til danskere i hele landet.  
  
Vi har åbent 365 dage om året, og med mere end 11.500 forskellige varer på hylderne kan vi dække alle indkøbsbehov. Vi har et kæmpe udvalg af økologiske varer, et stort discountsortiment samt unikke specialvarer fra udvalgte gård- og specialbutikker, såsom AC Perch’s Thehandel, Lagkagehuset og Slagter Lund.  
  
I dag er vi mere end 1400 medarbejdere i nemlig.com, som fra hovedsædet i Brøndby dækker et leveringsområde på mere end 83% af alle husstande i Danmark. Vi er dog i konstant udvikling, og ønsker hver dag at gøre det endnu sjovere, spændende og relevant at købe dagligvarer online.  
  
Ved at følge vores side kan du læse nyheder om vores seneste åbne stillinger, ligesom at du også kan læse de seneste nyheder fra vores virksomhed.

About Geodesic Capital
----------------------

Building a global company is never easy. The process of international expansion is still largely unautomated and the farther you are from home, the more useful local connections and know-how become. This is particularly true for growth stage entrepreneurs who typically see many clones of their businesses pop up worldwide, often with a local twist. Timely connected partners who know these markets can help you expand in an intelligent way and greatly improve your speed of execution to win the market.  
  
Geodesic Capital invests in rapidly growing technology companies facing exactly these problems. We help entrepreneurs as they expand into Asia – starting with Japan. Our team has extensive experience in both markets and is uniquely qualified to guide today’s most promising growth-stage companies as they embark on their global journey.  
  
Geodesic Capital is a new type of VC firm. Rooted in both Silicon Valley and Japan, we fund rapidly growing tech companies. We provide unparalleled access to senior-level executives, partners and government officials that our portfolio companies need to thrive abroad.  
  
On the ground, our subsidiary, Geodesic Japan, has a team of experts to provide unique market insights, sophisticated “go to market” strategies, introductions to top talent and key partners that companies need in order to start successfully.

About Sonny Garg

Sonny Garg serves as a Lecturer and Executive in Residence at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, where he leverages his extensive experience as a former Fortune 100 C-Suite executive to enrich the academic environment. With over 25 years of expertise in energy markets, commodity markets, and strategic financial planning, Sonny plays a pivotal role at Booth's Rustandy Center and the Executive MBA program. His focus on transforming mature organizations and fostering innovation in both private and non-profit sectors has made him a sought-after mentor and advisor for aspiring business leaders.  
  
At the Rustandy Center, Sonny is deeply involved in key projects that bridge the gap between theory and practice, helping students navigate the complexities of supply chain management and acquisition integration in today’s dynamic marketplace. His insights into transaction processing and IT strategy provide students with a comprehensive understanding of how to effectively manage and lead organizations through periods of transformation.  
  
Sonny’s approach emphasizes the importance of strategic planning and critical thinking, encouraging students to challenge conventional wisdom and explore new avenues for growth. His commitment to fostering a culture of innovation is evident in his curriculum, which integrates real-world case studies and hands-on projects. By sharing his wealth of knowledge in energy and power plant operations, Sonny equips the next generation of leaders with the tools they need to thrive in a rapidly evolving business landscape. His role at Booth not only enhances the academic experience but also contributes to the broader mission of developing socially responsible leaders who can make a meaningful impact in their respective fields.

Educating for the Future  
  
Marymount was founded by the Religious of the Sacred Heart of Mary (RSHM) in 1923. Today, it is the oldest international school in Paris and part of the Global Network of RSHM Schools, which includes 19 schools and a partnership with several missions in Africa. With less than 400 students, small average class sizes and an excellent student-adult ratio, Marymount offers a tailor made education that focuses on the individual needs and learning potential of every child.  
  
Marymount prides itself on embracing the natural diversity of its global community with over 51 nationalities on campus, whilst delivering an internationally accredited curriculum. Marymount students study a wide range of subjects and learn respectful teamwork, individual responsibility, and community service. Through varied activities, students grow in academic discipline and build essential life skills. Marymount ensures that the rigor and relevance of teaching takes place in a nurturing environment allowing each student to successfully grow and develop in an international setting.  
  
Marymount International School, Paris is accredited through the Middle States Association and the Council of International Schools.

About ELECTRO DEPOT
-------------------

ELECTRO DEPOT est une enseigne du groupe United.b (Boulanger, Krëfel ...). Créé en août 2003, ce concept est fortement inspiré d'enseignes de distribution américaines et européennes Low Cost (ex : COSTCO ou COLRUYT). Elle a intégré le Palmarès "Great Place To Work" des entreprises françaises où il fait bon travailler depuis trois années en se plaçant dans le TOP10 à chaque fois.  
  
ELECTRO DEPOT repose sur un concept doublement novateur dans son modèle de distribution et son volet humain. Sa politique humaine et la gestion de ses équipes font en effet figure d’exception dans le monde du Low Cost.  
  
Véritable alternative à la distribution classique, ELECTRO DEPOT couvre tous les besoins d’équipement des ménages (électro-ménager, image, son, multimédia…) et s’adresse à tous ceux qui veulent acheter utile, simple, malin et pas cher. Situés en périphérie des grandes agglomérations, les dépôts s’étendent sur des surfaces de 1.500 à 2.000 m2 et jouent la carte de la simplicité. Pas de décoration superflue, la priorité est donnée aux produits et aux prix. Les produits sont présentés sur palettes, en conditionnement et cartons d’origine. Ils sont neufs et de premier choix.  
  
En 2023, l’enseigne compte 92 magasins à travers la France, 13 en Belgique et 5 en Espagne, 1 site web marchand et plus de 1 800 collaborateurs.  
  
ELECTRO DEPOT veut également développer une politique Ressources Humaines ambitieuse, à l'image d'une entreprise où il fait bon vivre et bon travailler, avec une Académie interne pour favoriser la promotion de ses collaborateurs, des recrutements dans tous ses métiers, un système de rémunération globale motivant...  
  
Aujourd’hui à ce socle du LowCost nous voulons ADDITIONNER LA LOW IMPACT ATTITUDE : la planète en a besoin, nos clients vont l’exiger chaque jour un peu plus avec comme objectif de produire moins de carbone pour plus de solidarité !

Founded in 1571 by Queen Elizabeth I at the behest of Hugh Price, a Welsh lawyer and clergyman, the College is nestled in the heart of Oxford, featuring beautiful quadrangles off Turl Street. With a diverse student body of 340 undergraduates and 190 graduates, Jesus College prides itself on its inclusive environment, welcoming students from a variety of backgrounds and cultures. Approximately 90% of undergraduates hail from the UK, while nearly half of the graduate students come from 33 different countries, reflecting the College's commitment to global engagement.  
  
The teaching staff at Jesus College includes 68 Fellows and 20 College lecturers, who are dedicated to fostering an enriching academic experience. For those interested in the Jesus College Oxford teachers list, the College boasts a range of experts across various disciplines, ensuring that students receive top-notch education and mentorship. With over 5,300 alumni in touch across 84 countries, the College maintains a strong connection with its Old Members, evidenced by the return of over 800 alumni in the past year. Jesus College also opens its doors to conference and event guests during vacations, further enhancing its role as a vibrant community hub. For more information about this historic institution, please visit their website or reach out directly.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Electronic Industry Citizenship Coalition (EICC)

What is the Electronic Industry Citizenship Coalition (EICC)?

The Electronic Industry Citizenship Coalition (EICC) is a non-profit organization founded in 2004 that focuses on promoting social, ethical, and environmental responsibility within the electronics industry. The coalition brings together companies to collaborate on improving working conditions, ensuring human rights, and fostering sustainable practices throughout the electronics supply chain.

What services does EICC provide to its members?

EICC offers a variety of services to its members, including the development of a comprehensive Code of Conduct that sets standards for labor, health and safety, the environment, and ethics. Additionally, EICC provides training programs, resources for implementing best practices, and a Validated Audit Process (VAP) to assess compliance with the Code of Conduct. Members also benefit from networking opportunities and collaborative projects aimed at addressing industry-wide challenges.

How does EICC support sustainability in the electronics industry?

EICC supports sustainability through its commitment to responsible sourcing and manufacturing practices. The coalition encourages its members to adopt sustainable practices that minimize environmental impact, such as reducing waste, conserving energy, and using sustainable materials. EICC also collaborates with stakeholders to promote transparency and accountability in the supply chain, helping to ensure that environmental considerations are integrated into business operations.

What is the Validated Audit Process (VAP) and how does it work?

The Validated Audit Process (VAP) is a systematic approach developed by EICC to assess compliance with the EICC Code of Conduct. It involves independent third-party audits of member facilities to evaluate their adherence to labor, health and safety, environmental, and ethical standards. The VAP provides a framework for continuous improvement, allowing companies to identify areas for enhancement and implement corrective actions to address any non-compliance issues.

How can companies join the EICC and what are the membership requirements?

Companies interested in joining the EICC must demonstrate a commitment to the principles of social responsibility and ethical conduct outlined in the EICC Code of Conduct. Membership is open to all companies involved in the electronics supply chain, including manufacturers, suppliers, and service providers. Interested companies can apply for membership through the EICC website, where they will need to provide information about their operations and commitment to the coalition's goals.

What industries does EICC serve and how does it impact them?

EICC primarily serves the electronics industry, which includes sectors such as consumer electronics, telecommunications, and computer hardware. By promoting ethical labor practices, environmental sustainability, and corporate social responsibility, EICC impacts these industries by fostering a culture of accountability and transparency. This, in turn, helps companies mitigate risks, enhance their reputations, and build stronger relationships with stakeholders, including customers and investors.

Who is the CEO of Plan Vivo Foundation?

.

What is the Plan Vivo Standard and how does it support smallholders?

The Plan Vivo Standard is a framework designed to support smallholder farmers and communities in implementing sustainable land management practices. It provides guidelines for developing projects that enhance biodiversity, improve livelihoods, and promote conservation. By adhering to the Plan Vivo Standard, smallholders can access financial incentives through Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) and participate in voluntary carbon markets, thereby generating income while contributing to environmental sustainability.

How does Plan Vivo ensure the integrity and effectiveness of its projects?

Plan Vivo employs a rigorous project validation and verification process to ensure that all projects meet the established standards for environmental integrity and social equity. This includes baseline assessments, ongoing monitoring, and third-party verification. By maintaining transparency and accountability, Plan Vivo ensures that projects deliver real, measurable benefits to both the environment and local communities.

What types of projects are eligible under the Plan Vivo Standard?

Eligible projects under the Plan Vivo Standard typically focus on sustainable land use practices, reforestation, agroforestry, and conservation agriculture. These projects must demonstrate a clear benefit to biodiversity and local livelihoods while also contributing to climate change mitigation through carbon sequestration. The standard is particularly suited for smallholder-led initiatives that prioritize community involvement and sustainable development.

How can organizations or individuals get involved with Plan Vivo?

Organizations and individuals can get involved with Plan Vivo in several ways. They can support existing projects through funding or partnership opportunities, participate in capacity-building initiatives, or develop new projects that align with the Plan Vivo Standard. Additionally, individuals can contribute by raising awareness about the importance of sustainable land management and supporting policies that promote ecosystem services.

What are Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) and how do they work within the Plan Vivo framework?

Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) are financial incentives provided to landholders or communities for managing their land in ways that provide ecological benefits, such as carbon sequestration, biodiversity conservation, and water quality improvement. Within the Plan Vivo framework, PES are linked to verified project outcomes, allowing smallholders to receive payments based on the environmental services they provide. This creates a sustainable revenue stream for communities while promoting conservation efforts.

What impact does Plan Vivo have on local communities and biodiversity?

Plan Vivo has a significant positive impact on local communities and biodiversity by promoting sustainable land management practices that enhance ecosystem health and resilience. By empowering smallholders to engage in conservation efforts, Plan Vivo helps improve livelihoods, increase food security, and foster community cohesion. Additionally, the projects contribute to the preservation of biodiversity by protecting habitats and promoting sustainable agricultural practices, ultimately benefiting both people and the planet.

Jay White, the New Zealand professional wrestler, is a force to be reckoned with in the world of sports entertainment. Born on October 10, 1992, in Auckland, New Zealand, he embarked on a journey that would see him rise through the ranks and become a true superstar in the industry.

Dubbed "Switchblade," a nickname inspired by a villainous persona, his character exudes charisma and cunning, making him one of the most intriguing figures in professional wrestling. Whether he is executing technical maneuvers with precision or unleashing his aggressive and merciless side, White always keeps audiences on the edge of their seats.  
  
Throughout his career, White has engaged in fierce rivalries with some of the industry's most respected names. His battles with wrestlers like Kazuchika Okada, Hiroshi Tanahashi, and Tetsuya Naito have become legendary, showcasing his ability to adapt to different wrestling styles and tell captivating narratives in the ring. Each match is like a symphony, with White seamlessly blending artistry, technicality, and storytelling to create memorable moments that will be etched in the annals of wrestling history.  
  
Despite his accomplishments, Jay White remains humble and hungry for more success. He continues to push himself to the limit, constantly seeking new challenges and opportunities to grow as a performer. His dedication to his craft and unwavering work ethic have earned him the respect and admiration of his peers and fans alike.  
  
In the fast-paced world of professional wrestling, Jay White has emerged as a true luminary. With his unique blend of technical prowess, undeniable charisma, and an unwavering dedication to his craft, he stands tall as a testament to what can be achieved through hard work and determination. About ASSET Education
---------------------

Students are experiencing unprecedented levels of school-related stress and anxiety. In fact, the National Education Association labels the current rate of anxiety among adolescents as an “epidemic.”  
  
As an antidote to this epidemic, ASSET Education equips teachers with a curriculum of concrete tools to help their students reduce stress and build resilience. We envision school systems where all students flourish--where their abilities are not compromised by debilitating, school-related anxiety.  
  
To expose students to a variety of tools, ASSET is comprised of three modules: Mindfulness, Positive Psychology, and Positive Self-Talk. This design ensures that all students walk away with at least one new stress-reducing tool they like by the end of the academic year. We also worked with some of the best educators we know to turn our research-backed stress management tools into bite-sized social & emotional learning lessons that cater to teachers and the constraints of classroom life. Our ready-to-use curriculum is:  
  
\-intuitive  
\-time-sensitive (each lesson takes less than 10 minutes!)  
\-adaptable to any time of day: at the start of an academic class, during a morning meeting, or before a test.  
  
ASSET was built by teachers, for teachers.

What services does Kbit offer for cryptocurrency asset management?

Kbit specializes in high turnover, market neutral strategies that focus on capturing market structure inefficiencies. How does Kbit ensure the security of my cryptocurrency assets?

At Kbit, we prioritize the security of our clients' assets through a multi-layered approach. We utilize cold storage solutions for the majority of our holdings, employ advanced encryption protocols, and conduct regular security audits. Additionally, our team stays updated on the latest security practices in the cryptocurrency space to mitigate potential risks.

What industries does Kbit support with its cryptocurrency strategies?

Kbit serves a diverse range of industries, including finance, technology, and e-commerce. Our strategies are designed to cater to institutional investors, hedge funds, and high-net-worth individuals looking to diversify their portfolios with cryptocurrency assets. We also provide tailored solutions for businesses seeking to integrate cryptocurrency into their operations.

Can Kbit assist with regulatory compliance in cryptocurrency investments?

We recommend reaching out to our client relations team for detailed information on minimum investment requirements and to discuss personalized investment options that align with your financial goals.

How does Kbit's market making strategy work?

Kbit's market making strategy involves providing liquidity to cryptocurrency markets by placing buy and sell orders at various price levels. This approach helps to reduce price volatility and improve market efficiency. By capturing the bid-ask spread, we aim to generate consistent returns while maintaining a neutral market position, allowing us to capitalize on short-term price movements without taking directional risks.

About Onshape Inc.
------------------

Onshape is a next-generation SaaS design platform that speeds up product development. It’s an all-in-one system that combines CAD, release management, workflow, collaboration, analytics, admin tools, and an API with more than 50 engineering applications. Onshape helps extended design teams work together faster and helps executives make better business decisions with real-time analytics and unprecedented visibility into their company’s design and manufacturing processes.  
  
Thousands of companies rely on Onshape to modernize and streamline their product development cycle. Onshape users in 170+ countries have logged over 8 million hours modeling advanced robotics, biomedical devices, industrial machinery, agriculture equipment, and consumer products. With 1 in 8 sessions occurring on mobile devices, Onshape is the world's first anywhere, anytime product design platform.

.

What is Onshape and how does it differ from traditional CAD software?

Onshape is a cloud-based CAD platform that integrates design, collaboration, and product data management into a single system. Unlike traditional CAD software that is installed on local machines, Onshape operates entirely in the cloud, allowing users to access their designs from any device with an internet connection. This facilitates real-time collaboration among team members, eliminates version control issues, and streamlines the product development process.

What industries can benefit from using Onshape?

Onshape is versatile and can be utilized across various industries including mechanical engineering, product design, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, and 3D printing. Its robust features cater to the needs of engineers, designers, and manufacturers, making it an ideal solution for teams looking to enhance their design workflows and accelerate product development.

How does Onshape support collaboration among team members?

Onshape provides a collaborative environment where multiple users can work on the same design simultaneously. Features such as version control, real-time editing, comments, and notifications help teams communicate effectively and stay aligned throughout the design process. This reduces the time spent on back-and-forth communication and ensures that everyone is working with the most up-to-date information.

What tools does Onshape offer for product data management (PDM)?

Onshape includes built-in PDM capabilities that allow users to manage design data, track changes, and control access to files without the need for separate PDM software. Users can create custom workflows, manage release processes, and maintain a complete history of design revisions, all within the Onshape platform. This integration simplifies the management of complex design projects and enhances overall efficiency.

Can Onshape be integrated with other software and tools?

Yes, Onshape offers an API that allows for integration with various third-party applications and tools. This enables users to connect Onshape with their existing software ecosystem, such as ERP systems, PLM solutions, and other engineering tools. Additionally, Onshape supports integrations with popular applications for simulation, rendering, and project management, enhancing its functionality and adaptability to different workflows.

What support resources are available for Onshape users?

Onshape provides a variety of support resources including comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and a community forum where users can ask questions and share knowledge. Additionally, Onshape offers customer support through email and live chat for users who need assistance. For organizations looking for more personalized training, Onshape also provides professional services to help teams get the most out of the platform.

About Nationwide Children's Hospital
------------------------------------

Nationwide Children’s is one of America's largest pediatric hospitals, an international leader in research and is ranked in all 10 specialties on U.S. News & World Report’s 2023-24 “America’s Best Children’s Hospitals” list. Our staff, comprised of 1,500 medical professionals and over 13,000 employees, provides state-of-the-art pediatric care for 1.6 million patient visits annually. And, according to the Children’s Hospital Association, Nationwide Children's is the #1 provider of pediatric surgery in the country.  
  
As home to the Department of Pediatrics of The Ohio State University College of Medicine, Nationwide Children’s physicians train the next generation of pediatricians and pediatric specialists. The Abigail Wexner Research Institute at Nationwide Children’s Hospital is one of the Top 10 National Institutes of Health-funded freestanding pediatric research facilities. Nationwide Children’s remains true to the original mission since its founding in 1892 of providing care regardless of a family’s ability to pay. More information is available at NationwideChildrens.org.  
  
Our doctors represent every major pediatric sub-specialty. With over 50 locations throughout Ohio, signature programs include heart, cancer, gastroenterology and neonatology care, all of which are internationally recognized. Tim Robinson is CEO of Nationwide Children’s Hospital, which includes the Abigail Wexner Research Institute at Nationwide Children’s Hospital, Nationwide Children’s Hospital Foundation and The Center for Family Safety and Healing at Nationwide Children’s Hospital.

About City of Pittsburg
-----------------------

The City of Pittsburg is a culturally rich and diverse community of over 74,000 residents and expected to grow to 90,000 in the next 20 years. Pittsburg is located in the Bay Area Region of Northern California and is perfectly situated for easy access to San Francisco, Napa Valley, Sacramento, the foothills of the Sierra Nevada Mountains, and Lake Tahoe. Pittsburg City Hall is also conveniently located a short walk from the Pittsburg Center Station of the Bay Area Rapid Transit System (BART), making a commute from cities throughout the Bay Area very easy. Pittsburg has waterfront homes, a performing arts theater, a variety of seasonal events, an extensive park system, a large public-school system, and a variety of shopping centers. The recently renovated Marina is also an ideal place to visit and is located within steps of the Old Town shopping district and downtown living, with nearly 600 boat slips, a free public boat launch, fuel dock, café, bait shop, and the Pittsburg Yacht Club. Pittsburg has featured such events as the Seafood and Music Festival, car shows, movies in the park, kayaking, and fishing derbies. With its commitment to a quality community environment, Pittsburg is an ideal city in which to live, work and recreate.  
  
The City of Pittsburg is a full-service city following the council-manager form of government. We have about 290 full time employees and about 350 employees total (depending on the season). Pittsburg is currently organized into the following departments: City Management, Community and Economic Development (Building, Economic Development, Code Enforcement, and Planning), Community Services (Housing Authority, Pittsburg Power Company, and the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency), Recreation, Human Resources, Finance, Police, and Public Works (Engineering, Operations/Maintenance, Utilities, Facilities, Parks, and Water Treatment). Fire Protection services are provided by the Contra Costa County Consolidated Fire Dept

About Shenkar - Engineering. Design. Art.
-----------------------------------------

“Shenkar - Engineering. Design. Art” has established itself as one of the leading colleges in Israel. Every year, Shenkar's graduates find themselves in the forefront of research and the industry, exhibit their works, participate in competitions and win prestigious awards.  
  
Combining faculties of engineering, design and art is the basis of this institution’s unique multidisciplinary academics, allowing students and professors to combine cutting-edge technologies with contemporary design and artistic concepts. Each faculty has its own character, yet maintains fruitful collaborations with the other faculties, exposing students to a variety of disciplines and different fields of knowledge.  
  
In the Pernick Faculty of Engineering, 5 departments offer a Bachelor’s Degree in Science (B.Sc.): the Department of Industrial Engineering and Management, the Department of Plastics Engineering, the Department of Software Engineering and the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering. A Master’s Degree program is offered in the Department of Plastics Engineering and the Department of Industrial Engineering and Management, which offers a unique program for those qualified.  
In the Azrieli Faculty of Design, 6 departments offer a Bachelor’s Degree in Design (B.Des): The Department of Visual Communications, The Department of Textile Design, the Department of Interior - Building and Environment Design, the Department of Jewelry Design, the Department of Industrial Design and the Department of Fashion Design, considered one of the best of its kind worldwide.  
  
In 2008, a new department was established, the Department of Multidisciplinary Art, which offers a Bachelor’s Degree in Fine Arts (B.F.A), and later, the unique program for a Master’s Degree in Design was introduced (M.Des), offering either a thesis or non-thesis routes for a degree in Fashion, Textile, Jewelry and Accessories Design.

What services does InGo offer to enhance event marketing?

InGo provides a comprehensive suite of services designed to enhance event marketing through innovative technology. Our platform enables businesses to leverage social media and word-of-mouth marketing to increase event attendance and engagement. Key features include personalized event invitations, social sharing tools, and analytics that track attendee interactions. By utilizing our solutions, businesses can create richer experiences for their attendees and foster a community around their events.

How does InGo's software improve social media marketing efforts?

InGo's software enhances social media marketing by enabling brands to tap into their existing networks and advocates. Our platform allows users to easily share event details and promotions across various social media channels, amplifying reach and engagement. Additionally, our analytics tools provide insights into social media performance, helping businesses refine their strategies and maximize their marketing efforts. This results in more authentic connections with potential customers and increased brand visibility.

What industries can benefit from InGo's solutions?

InGo's solutions are versatile and can benefit a wide range of industries, including but not limited to technology, education, healthcare, and entertainment. Any business that hosts events or engages with customers through social media can leverage our platform to enhance their marketing efforts. Our tools are particularly effective for organizations looking to drive attendance at conferences, trade shows, and community events, as well as those aiming to build stronger relationships with their audiences.

Can InGo help with influencer marketing strategies?

Yes, InGo is well-equipped to assist businesses with their influencer marketing strategies. Our platform allows brands to identify and engage with key influencers within their industry, facilitating partnerships that can amplify marketing efforts. By leveraging our tools, businesses can create campaigns that encourage influencers to share their events and promotions, thereby reaching a wider audience and enhancing brand credibility through trusted voices.

What is advocate marketing, and how does InGo support it?

Advocate marketing is a strategy that focuses on turning satisfied customers into brand advocates who promote your business through word-of-mouth. InGo supports advocate marketing by providing tools that enable businesses to identify their most enthusiastic customers and empower them to share their experiences. Our platform facilitates easy sharing of events and promotions on social media, helping to create a community of advocates who can drive organic growth and enhance brand loyalty.

How does InGo measure the success of marketing campaigns?

InGo measures the success of marketing campaigns through robust analytics and reporting features. Our platform tracks key performance indicators such as event attendance, social media engagement, and referral traffic generated from advocate shares. By analyzing this data, businesses can gain insights into what strategies are working and where improvements can be made. This data-driven approach allows companies to refine their marketing efforts and achieve better results over time.

About UK Biocentre
------------------

UK Biocentre provides a centre of excellence for biomedical research to the academic, pharmaceutical and biotech research community.  
  
UK Biocentre was established in 2011 as the service arm of UK Biobank, a national research initiative that collected biological samples and data from 500,000 UK volunteers. UK Biobank is regarded as the world’s premier biobank and implemented an industrialised approach to biological sample processing and management that is now available, through UK Biocentre, to the international scientific research community.  
  
UK Biocentre exists to support global biomedical research providing world class sample processing, storage and analysis services. UK Biocentre’s storage facility provides access to automated sample storage systems from the world’s leading automated storage system providers, in addition to conventional -20°C, -80°C and -196°C cryostorage systems, for the storage of biological fluids, tissue and compounds.  
  
Extensive sample processing robotics provide platforms to process blood and other biological fluids into their constituent parts, to desired volumes and concentrations, under environmentally controlled conditions.  
  
A wide sample analysis capability exists including high throughput nucleic acid extraction, genotyping, sequencing, biochemical assay and immunoassay.

About Discovery Yachts
----------------------

The Discovery Shipyard was founded in 1998 and is the leading British builder of luxury blue-water cruising yachts designed for simple two handed sailing. More than a decade on the company is a thriving business employing up to 100 skilled workers who build the highest quality yachts at its 40,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Marchwood, near Southampton, Great Britain. The management team is dedicated to providing a unique service that is defined by the ingenuity of its designs, build quality and customer care.  
  
The Discovery Shipyard yachts are well known for clever features, custom designed innovation as well as the high level of standard equipment installed and included in every yacht. The current range are the Discovery Hull 55, 58 and 67 fixed keel yachts, the Southerly 42, 48 and 54 lifting keel yachts as well as the award-winning Bluewater 50 catamaran by Discovery. (Mk 3 version now available).  
Renowned for their fast performance and easy motion, the Discovery Shipyard range was designed by Ron Holland, Stephen Jones and Ed Dubois to ensure exhilarating and effortless passage making. Dixon Yacht Designs created the design of the Bluewater 50 Catamaran which offers spacious on-board living with world-class sailing. All of the yachts have a light and airy, contemporary interiors, some designed by Ken Freivokh with their hallmark raised saloons offering panoramic vision.  
Discovery Yachts are the ultimate world class cruising yachts; fast, beautifully balance and designed to take two people around the world in safety with exceptional comfort. Owning a Discovery is the ultimate experience of a lifetime.

This exposure to different cultures and perspectives would greatly influence his acclaimed comic strip, "The Boondocks," which made its debut in 1996.  
  
The Boondocks introduced readers to the Freeman family, an African-American family navigating life in the predominantly white suburb of Woodcrest. McGruder used the strip as a platform to explore issues of racism, inequality, and the African-American experience in a clever and unapologetic manner. The strip garnered a loyal following who appreciated McGruder's willingness to tackle controversial subjects head-on and expose the often uncomfortable realities of American society.  
  
McGruder's unique voice and talent for combining humor with social criticism earned him both praise and criticism. Some hailed him as a champion of free speech and applauded his ability to shed light on important issues. Despite the mixed reception, "The Boondocks" gained widespread recognition, leading to a successful animated adaptation that aired on Adult Swim from 2005 to 2014. The show expanded McGruder's reach and allowed him to reach an even larger audience with his biting satire.  
  
One of the factors that made McGruder's work so impactful was his authentic portrayal of the African-American experience. He fearlessly explored topics that were often considered taboo, using his characters to challenge stereotypes and confront systemic injustices. McGruder's ability to tackle serious issues while injecting humor into his narratives created a unique and engaging storytelling style that resonated with many.  
  
Throughout his career, McGruder has not been afraid to take risks, often using his platform to push boundaries and challenge societal norms. This can be seen in his controversial comic strip, "The Super N\*\*ger," which gained significant attention for its inflammatory title. The film was praised for shedding light on an often overlooked chapter in American history and received positive reviews for its artistry and storytelling.  
  
McGruder's impact on popular culture goes beyond his comic strips and film projects. He has become a prominent voice in the conversation on race and politics, often sharing his views through social media platforms. His passionate and unapologetic approach has earned him both support and backlash, yet he continues to use his platform to advocate for social justice and challenge prevailing narratives.  
  
In conclusion, Aaron McGruder's work as an American writer and cartoonist has left an indelible mark on popular culture. Through his groundbreaking comic strip, "The Boondocks," and other creative projects, he fearlessly tackles contentious issues such as race, politics, and identity. His commitment to excellence, combined with his infectious charisma, has solidified him as one of the most exciting and respected players in American baseball.  
  
In conclusion, Eric Hosmer's journey from a talented youngster to a revered veteran is a testament to his unwavering dedication and exceptional skill set. About U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
----------------------------------------

The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) is an independent agency that was established by the Energy Reorganization Act of 1974 and began operations in 1975.  
  
NRC’s mission is to license and regulate the Nation’s civilian use of radioactive materials to provide reasonable assurance of adequate protection of public health and safety and to promote the common defense and security and to protect the environment. In carrying out its mission it exercises the following vision: Demonstrate the Principles of Good Regulation (independence, openness, efficiency, clarity, and reliability) in performing our mission.  
  
Working at NRC offers a unique opportunity to experience a career where your impact reaches across the country and around the world. We need a wide variety of administrative and technical staff to accomplish our objectives. We hire engineers, scientists, security specialists, information technology professionals, financial analysts, and a range of other occupations. Whether you’re a student, recent college graduate, veteran, someone with nuclear industry experience, or a current government employee looking for a new opportunity, the NRC can offer you a competitive salary and a fulfilling career.

What is CollegeFashionista and how does it operate?

CollegeFashionista is a global community that connects students passionate about fashion and lifestyle trends on college campuses. The platform allows students to share their personal style, insights on fashion trends, and experiences through blog posts, social media, and other digital content. By creating a space for students to express their creativity, CollegeFashionista fosters a network of aspiring fashionistas who can engage with one another and with brands looking to reach a younger audience.

How can students get involved with CollegeFashionista?

Students can get involved with CollegeFashionista by applying to become a Style Guru. As a Style Guru, they will have the opportunity to write articles, take photos, and create content that showcases the fashion trends at their respective campuses. This role not only allows students to build their portfolios but also connects them with a community of like-minded individuals and potential career opportunities in the fashion and media industries.

What types of content can I find on CollegeFashionista?

CollegeFashionista features a variety of content including style guides, trend reports, beauty tips, and lifestyle articles. The platform highlights student fashion from various campuses, offering insights into local trends and personal styles. Additionally, CollegeFashionista collaborates with brands to provide sponsored content and advertising opportunities that align with the interests of its audience.

Can brands collaborate with CollegeFashionista?

Yes, brands can collaborate with CollegeFashionista to reach a targeted audience of college students interested in fashion and lifestyle. The platform offers various advertising solutions, including sponsored posts, social media campaigns, and influencer partnerships with Style Gurus. These collaborations help brands engage with a younger demographic and promote their products in an authentic and relatable way.

What are the benefits of being a Style Guru at CollegeFashionista?

Being a Style Guru at CollegeFashionista comes with numerous benefits. Style Gurus gain valuable experience in content creation, photography, and social media marketing. They also have the opportunity to build their personal brand, network with industry professionals, and potentially receive internships or job offers from fashion and media companies. Additionally, Style Gurus can enhance their resumes and portfolios by showcasing their work to a global audience.

Is CollegeFashionista only focused on fashion, or does it cover other lifestyle topics?

While CollegeFashionista primarily focuses on fashion, it also covers a wide range of lifestyle topics including beauty, wellness, and college life. The platform aims to provide a holistic view of the student experience, incorporating various aspects of lifestyle that resonate with its audience. This diverse content approach allows readers to find inspiration not just in fashion, but in their overall college journey.

What services does Skillshot Media offer?

Skillshot Media specializes in providing comprehensive marketing solutions tailored for the gaming industry. Our services include influencer marketing, community management, social media strategy, content creation, and event management. We focus on connecting brands with gamers through innovative campaigns and strategic partnerships.

Which industries does Skillshot Media support?

Skillshot Media primarily supports the gaming and esports industries. We work with game developers, publishers, and esports organizations to enhance their visibility and engagement with target audiences. Our expertise also extends to tech companies and brands looking to enter the gaming space or connect with the gaming community.

How can Skillshot Media help my gaming brand grow?

Skillshot Media can help your gaming brand grow by leveraging our extensive network of influencers and gamers to create authentic marketing campaigns. We tailor our strategies to align with your brand's goals, whether it's increasing game downloads, boosting community engagement, or driving sales. Our data-driven approach ensures that we optimize campaigns for maximum impact.

What is influencer marketing and how does Skillshot Media implement it?

Influencer marketing involves partnering with individuals who have a significant following in the gaming community to promote your brand or product. Active Biotech AB (publ) (NASDAQ Stockholm: ACTI) is a biotechnology company that deploys its extensive knowledge base and portfolio of compounds to develop first-in-class immunomodulatory treatments for specialist oncology and immunology indications with a high unmet medical need and significant commercial potential. Following a portfolio refocus, the business model of Active Biotech aims to advance projects to the clinical development phase and then further develop the programs internally or pursue in partnership. Active Biotech currently holds three projects in its portfolio: The wholly owned small molecule immunomodulators, tasquinimod and laquinimod, both having a mode of actions that includes modulation of myeloid immune cell function, are targeted towards hematological malignancies and inflammatory eye disorders, respectively. About Harmony Korines

Harmony Korine is an American filmmaker, writer, and actor known for his unconventional and controversial approach to storytelling. Born in 1973 in Bolinas, California, Korine rose to prominence in the 1990s with his provocative and raw portrayal of American subcultures. He is best known for his work on films such as "Kids," "Gummo," "Spring Breakers," and "The Beach Bum," which have solidified his reputation as a visionary director with a unique and uncompromising vision.  
  
Korine began his career as a writer, penning the script for Larry Clark's coming-of-age drama "Kids" at the age of 19. The film, which follows a group of New York City teenagers as they navigate drugs, sex, and mortality, sparked controversy and garnered critical acclaim for its unflinching portrayal of youth culture. This early success established Korine as a bold and boundary-pushing storyteller, unafraid to tackle taboo subjects and challenge societal norms.  
  
In 1997, Korine made his directorial debut with "Gummo," a visually striking and unsettling exploration of life in a small town ravaged by poverty and decay. Utilizing a nonlinear narrative and an eclectic visual style, the film received mixed reviews but garnered a cult following for its raw and unfiltered depiction of American society's underbelly. This willingness to confront the darker aspects of human existence would become a recurring theme in Korine's work, distinguishing him as a filmmaker unafraid to explore the fringes of humanity.  
  
Korine continued to push boundaries with subsequent projects, including the experimental drama "Julien Donkey-Boy" and the dreamlike crime thriller "Mister Lonely," both of which showcased his idiosyncratic storytelling and penchant for capturing the surreal and absurd. However, it was his 2012 film "Spring Breakers" that brought Korine widespread attention and commercial success. Starring James Franco, Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, and Ashley Benson, the film follows a group of college girls who descend into a hedonistic world of crime and excess during spring break. With its neon-drenched visuals, hypnotic soundtrack, and subversive themes, "Spring Breakers" solidified Korine's reputation as a filmmaker unafraid to challenge traditional cinematic conventions and societal expectations.  
  
In 2019, Korine released "The Beach Bum," a comedic drama starring Matthew McConaughey as a rebellious and hedonistic poet living in the Florida Keys. The film received mixed reviews but once again exemplified Korine's unique voice and unapologetic approach to storytelling. With its vibrant color palette, offbeat characters, and irreverent humor, "The Beach Bum" further cemented Korine's status as a filmmaker who defies categorization and consistently pushes the boundaries of cinematic expression.  
  
Aside from his work behind the camera, Korine has also made appearances as an actor in several films, often portraying eccentric and unpredictable characters that mirror the unconventional nature of his filmmaking. His willingness to blur the lines between creator and performer further underscores his commitment to challenging norms and expectations within the film industry.  
  
Throughout his career, Harmony Korine has remained a divisive and influential figure in the world of independent cinema, inspiring a new generation of filmmakers to embrace risk-taking and authenticity in their storytelling. With his fearless exploration of taboo subjects, unconventional storytelling techniques, and uncompromising vision, Korine has carved out a unique place in the cinematic landscape, solidifying his legacy as a true maverick of American filmmaking.

About GammaDelta Therapeutics
-----------------------------

GammaDelta Therapeutics is a UK headquartered biotechnology company founded upon world-class academic research conducted by Professor Adrian Hayday and Dr Oliver Nussbaumer, at King’s College London and the Francis Crick Institute and supported by Cancer Research Technology.  
  
GammaDelta Therapeutics aims to harness the unique properties of γδ T cells to improve patient outcomes and survival rates among patients with haematological malignancies and solid tumours.  
  
Our mission is to deliver highly effective allogeneic immunotherapies based on the unique properties of Vδ1+ T cells with potential to provide additional benefits towards patient survival in the treatment of cancers. Our proprietary isolation and expansion protocols have the ability to selectively generate Vδ1+ T cell populations suitable for clinical application.  
  
The Company’s technologies are based upon pioneering world-class research conducted by Professor Adrian Hayday and Dr Oliver Nussbaumer, at King’s College London and the Francis Crick Institute, and Professor Bruno Silva-Santos at the University of Lisbon.  
  
GammaDelta’s technology has been recognised for its therapeutic potential, attracting interest from the pharmaceutical industry and investment from Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited and Abingworth LLP.

About Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency
-------------------------------------------------

The Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency was created to ensure the ongoing development of affordable housing and to continuously fuel community redevelopment projects in the city and county of Sacramento. We meet these goals by creating safer neighborhoods and a more robust economy, so individuals, families and children in our community have the opportunity for a better life. Our work has been recognized among the best in the country by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development and others. Every day, our team of over 230 employees secures funding, battles for support, organizes our partners and engages the Sacramento community in a proactive collaboration to change lives. We focus our efforts on four main areas to achieve our mission.  
  
Our Mission - Changing Lives  
The Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency’s Mission Statement conveys the essence of the organization and serves as the foundation for our Vision and Goals. Our mission is to revitalize communities, provide affordable housing opportunities and to serve as the Housing Authority for the City and County of Sacramento.  
  
SHRA is working to fulfill these goals:  
  
Develop, preserve and finance a continuum of affordable housing opportunities for Sacramento City and County residents  
Effectively and efficiently maintain Agency-owned housing by providing tenant-based rental assistance programs  
Revitalize lower income neighborhoods to create healthy and sustainable communities  
Promote economic development through strategic infrastructure and public facility improvements.  
  
SHRA has a FY 2018 budget of $190.7 million and approximately 232 employees. The Agency owns/ manages 2,7-- units of affordable housing and is one of the largest landlords in Sacramento. SHRA also administers approximately 12,900 rental assistance vouchers per month.

Workshops at Design Dept. are interactive and focused on practical application. Participants can expect to engage in hands-on activities, group discussions, and real-world case studies that foster collaboration and creativity. Each workshop is designed to provide actionable insights and strategies that participants can implement immediately in their roles as creative leaders.

Design Dept. provides targeted coaching and development programs specifically designed for new leaders. These programs focus on building essential leadership skills, such as effective communication, team management, and strategic thinking. Through personalized coaching sessions and workshops, new leaders learn how to navigate their new responsibilities and lead their teams with confidence.

Can Design Dept. assist organizations in improving their overall organizational design?

Yes, Design Dept. specializes in organizational design and can help organizations optimize their structure and processes to enhance efficiency and creativity. They work with leadership teams to analyze current workflows, identify areas for improvement, and implement strategies that align with the organization's goals and culture, ultimately fostering a more innovative and agile environment.

Carle Health is a vertically integrated system with a bold but simple mission: to be the trusted partner in all healthcare decisions for everyone who depends on it. Combining clinical care, health insurance, medical research and higher education, Carle Health provides highly accessible, high-quality care and service to improve health in communities throughout central Illinois and beyond. Always focused on its North Star – providing the best care possible for patients and health plan members – Carle Health is driven by a deep philanthropic spirit to solve real-world health issues now and into the future.  
  
The system includes eight, award-winning hospitals, multispecialty physician group practices with more than 1,300 doctors and advanced practice providers, provider-driven health insurance plans including Health AllianceTM and FirstCarolinaCare, Carle Illinois College of Medicine, the world’s first engineering-based medical school, Methodist College, Stephens Family Clinical Research Institute, and other associated healthcare businesses – all working together to get patients and health plan members the care they need at the right time and at every point in their healthcare journey.  
  
Founded in Urbana, IL, Carle Health has more than 16,800 team members working across Illinois, Indiana, Washington and North Carolina. It’s proud to be named a Great Place to Work®.

Big Live's social networking technology differentiates itself from the competition by allowing users to communicate effectively through chat room size limits that promote interaction when joining strangers in the crowd, private group chat for friends, and one to one chat for everyone. Pulse Biosciences is the inventor and sole proprietor of Nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation™ (nsPFA™) technology. We are committed to health innovation that has the potential to improve and extend the lives of patients. Our proprietary Nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation technology delivers nanosecond pulses of electrical energy to non-thermally clear cells while sparing adjacent non-cellular tissue.  
  
The people at Pulse Biosciences are some of the top experts in pulsed electric field technologies and have a broad range of engineering expertise across multiple medical device domains and will utilize nsPFA™ technology to treat a variety of applications for which an optimal solution remains unfulfilled.  
  
We have a deep and broad IP portfolio with over 130 issued patents globally owned and licensed. With this growing patent portfolio surrounding our innovative technology, Pulse Biosciences seeks to aggressively realize the potential of Nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation technology by building a rich pipeline of transformative commercial applications.

Fundada em 1995, a SuperBAC é uma empresa de soluções em biotecnologia, com o objetivo de promover a sustentabilidade nos processos produtivos das áreas do agronegócio, saneamento, energia, biorremediação e varejo.  
Com unidades fabris e centros de pesquisa e desenvolvimento no Brasil, Estados Unidos e Colômbia, seu principal objetivo é criar alternativas ambientalmente corretas e economicamente viáveis, que contribuem de maneira decisiva para o desenvolvimento sustentável do planeta. A SuperBAC defende a introdução da plataforma biotecnológica para o desenvolvimento sustentável do planeta.  
\---------------  
SuperBAC is a Biotechnology company established in 1995 focused in providing sustainable products and solutions in agribusiness, sanitation, oil & gas, bioremediation and retail.  
With manufacturing facilities and research and development in Brazil, Colombia and the United States, its main goal is to create environmentally correct and economically viable alternatives, contributing decisively to the sustainable development of the planet.

We have experience of a vast range of markets and technologies and are always seeking to broaden our horizons even further. A can-do attitude prevails and, when asked by our clients if we can help with their new requirements, the answer is usually yes.

Our track record in these key areas has earned us both an impressive reputation and a loyal customer base who respect and trust us.

About City of Berkeley
----------------------

The City of Berkeley is distinguished by its diversity, community engagement, and activism. Home to the University of California’s flagship campus, Berkeley’s population is highly educated, diverse, and engaged. The City lies on the east shore of the San Francisco Bay and is sheltered by rolling hills on its eastern border. Berkeley spans 10 square miles with 124,000 residents.  
  
Our climate is mild year-round, with cool summers. An outdoor focus is demonstrated with acres of open space, parks, and an abundance of bike lanes on City streets. Public transportation is well developed and reliable, with three Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) stations in Berkeley. All of these factors translate to an outstanding quality of life for Berkeley residents, with an abundance of outdoor, recreational, and cultural activities.  
  
The City of Berkeley lies in Alameda County and operates under a Council-Manager form of government. The City is divided into eight districts, and each district elects one representative to the City Council. The eight-member City Council serves four-year terms, and a mayor is elected at large – also on a four-year term.  
  
The City Council appoints a City Manager, who serves as the Chief Executive of the City. Berkeley provides a comprehensive range of municipal services to its population, many of which are not typically provided by cities. In addition to the customary city services, the City of Berkeley operates its own Health, Housing and Community Services Department, providing public health, mental health, and environmental health services to the community.  
  
The City also provides its own residential and commercial solid waste collection, recycling, and disposal service. In addition, the City’s Parks, Recreation, and Waterfront Department offers a number of summer camps and operates a 1,000-berth marina.  
  
Join the City of Berkeley team. Apply for open positions on our jobs page.

About Biocare Medical
---------------------

Biocare Medical LLC is an innovator in automated immunohistochemistry (IHC) instrumentation, and the full range of reagents for IHC and in situ hybridization (ISH; RISH) testing. Biocare pioneered multiplex IHC detection which accelerates turnaround time, increases instrument productivity and reduces reagent consumption and cost by 50% or more.  
  
Multiplex IHC allows pathologists to visualize more than one marker on a tissue at a time, allowing higher confidence for critical differentiation.  
  
Biocare's intelliPATH FLX is the only completely open, continuous random access IHC instrument available.  
The company’s customers come from clinical and research environments that do tissue based testing and include histology laboratories, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies; CROs; and academic, government and military labs. Biocare Medical offers an expanding portfolio of products for the rapidly growing cancer and infectious disease diagnostic and research markets. Biocare medical is headquartered and has manufacturing facilities in Concord, Calif., and has a global distribution network. See biocare.net and slidestainer.com for more information.  
  
NOTE: Biocare Medical, the Biocare Medical logo, and intelliPATH are trademarks of Biocare Medical LLC.

Mercer University, headquartered in Macon, Georgia, is one of the oldest and most distinguished institutions of higher education in the United States. Founded in the early 19th century by Baptists, Mercer has evolved into a comprehensive university that offers a wide range of rigorous academic programs, from undergraduate liberal arts to advanced doctoral degrees. While it is no longer formally affiliated with the Baptist denomination, the university continues to embrace the core principles of intellectual and religious freedom that are rooted in its historical context. This commitment fosters an educational environment where students are encouraged to explore diverse perspectives and engage in critical thinking.  
  
Mercer University prides itself on its dedicated faculty, who are not only experts in their fields but also passionate educators committed to student success. About American Board Of Optometry
---------------------------------

The American Board of Optometry provides Board Certification and Maintenance of Certification for the profession of optometry. Board Certified doctors of optometry demonstrate their ongoing competence and commitment to quality through lifelong learning and self-assessment. Patients can feel confident in the care of an optometrist who is Board Certified by the American Board of Optometry.  
  
The American Board of Optometry’s mission is to continually improve patient care by helping optometrists demonstrate ongoing commitment to professional enrichment. This is done through the organization’s voluntary, NCCA-certified Board Certification program and CMS-approved Maintenance of Certification process. The American Board of Optometry was founded in 2009 by the American Academy of Optometry, American Optometric Association, American Optometric Student Association and the Association of Schools and Colleges of Optometry. For information, visit www.americanboardofoptometry.org.

Who are the decision makers in American Board Of Optometry?
