About Borusan Mannesmann
------------------------

Borusan Mannesmann; has its signature in everything we come across by in daily life. The roads we pass over, in transmission of gas, water, and oil we use, the motor vehicles we use with confidence every day, the buildings in which we live, the machinery and vehicles around us and all the systems and structures surrounding us... Borusan Mannesmann is sustaining the duty and responsibility of life; providing secure products and services that can be trusted for life... Borusan Mannesmann is among the leading steel pipe manufacturers in Europe and in the world with one million tons of production capacity. Major objectives of BMB can be followed as promoting the position of Turkish industrialists as being a guiding force in the pipe industry and international recognition. Borusan Mannesmann is investing in the future projects of the Turkish economy. While exporting products to various countries in America, Europe, and Asia, Borusan Mannesmann contributes to Turkey and it also grows into one of the main driving forces of the Turkish economy due to its assurance for future developments. Utilizing its experience to the markets overseas, especially in Iran, Algeria, Europe and the U.S., Borusan Mannesmann has successfully accomplished producing pipes for numerous major energy, oil, and gas pipeline projects. The name of Borusan Mannesmann Boru can be found under many great worldwide projects. The company provides products for various international projects such as The Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan Pipeline, The NK1 Oil Pipeline, The Şahdeniz, The Blue Stream, The Turkey-Greece-Hungary Gas Pipeline and The United States Elba Express Natural Gas Pipeline projects. The Elba Express Project, with a budget of 170 million dollars, has been called one of the greatest projects being achieved by a Turkish manufacturer in the U.S.

About Epicure™
--------------

As the processed food industry has grown, so have food-related illnesses like obesity and diabetes that now face our next generation in alarming numbers. That’s not ok.  
  
Sylvie Rochette founded Epicure in 1997 with a passion to share the clean eating solutions she had created for her family. Today, Sylvie and her daughter, CEO Amelia Warren, are uniting time-starved families that want to reconnect across the table to share good food, eat healthier, and live better.  
  
At Epicure, we are a community that unites and inspires each other to rally around clean eating. Epicure is dedicated to sharing delicious meal solutions that use only real, whole ingredients you can trust, while never ever compromising on taste.  
  
We educate and inspire our community with a three-course solution—for ourselves, our children, and our planet. Our mission is to take back our health and change the course of our next generation's health and relationship with food.  
  
We believe that with great success comes the responsibility to give generously—Epicure donates 5% of pre-tax profits to charity and created the Epicure Foundation™, which supports community projects and grassroots food initiatives across Canada.  
  
Epicure's Home Team work out of our beautiful office in North Saanich, BC, where all of our products are designed, manufactured and shipped out to happy consultants and customers across Canada. We have over 170 talented people working in our Creative & Marketing, Research & Development, Finance, HR, IT, Customer Experience, Sales, Operations and Distribution teams.  
  
Culture and values are extremely important to us at Epicure as we continually work to ensure our employees are inspired, engaged, and enabled to grow. We believe in recognizing and rewarding talented people, and as we continue to build on our success, we're always growing our teams. If you want to work for a company with great people, a collaborative culture, and the opportunity to build your skills, get in touch with us.

Who is the CEO of Epicure™?

Who are the decision makers in Epicure™?

.

What types of meals does Epicure offer?

Epicure specializes in providing a wide range of healthy, fast, and great-tasting meals that cater to various dietary preferences, including gluten-free, vegetarian, and low-carb options. Their meal solutions are designed to be quick and easy to prepare, making them ideal for busy individuals and families looking to maintain a healthy lifestyle without sacrificing flavor.

How does Epicure support entrepreneurs in Canada?

Epicure offers a unique entrepreneurial opportunity for Canadians through its direct sales model. Individuals can become Epicure Consultants, allowing them to run their own business by selling Epicure products. The company provides training, resources, and support to help consultants succeed, making it a viable option for those looking to earn extra income while promoting healthy eating.

Are Epicure's products suitable for individuals with dietary restrictions?

Yes, Epicure's products are designed to accommodate various dietary restrictions. Many of their meal solutions are gluten-free, dairy-free, and low in sugar, making them suitable for individuals with specific health concerns such as diabetes or food allergies. Epicure also provides detailed ingredient lists and nutritional information to help customers make informed choices.

Can I find Epicure products in stores, or are they only available online?

Epicure products are primarily available through their network of consultants and on their official website. This direct sales approach allows customers to receive personalized service and recommendations. While some products may be available at select events or pop-up shops, the best way to access the full range of Epicure offerings is through their online platform.

What is the philosophy behind Epicure's meal solutions?

Epicure's philosophy revolves around making healthy eating accessible and enjoyable for everyone. The company believes that nutritious meals should be easy to prepare and delicious, helping to combat the rising rates of food-related illnesses like obesity and diabetes. By providing quick meal solutions and promoting healthy cooking practices, Epicure aims to empower individuals and families to take control of their health.

How can I get involved with Epicure as a consultant?

Getting involved with Epicure as a consultant is simple. Interested individuals can visit the Epicure website to learn more about the consultant opportunity, including the benefits, training, and support provided. Once ready, they can sign up online, choose a starter kit, and begin their journey as an Epicure Consultant, sharing healthy meal solutions with their community while building their own business.

Centerline delivers the expertise it takes today to recruit safe, compliant drivers precisely matched to each customer’s needs so they can improve productivity, control costs and deliver superior service to their customers.  
  
Centerline has connected over 50,000 drivers with Fortune 1000 and mid-sized companies since its founding in 1975. Professional drivers rely on us as their coach to find satisfying jobs where they can excel. Each driver we employ knows they will work with a team that is professional, courteous, resourceful and respectful.  
  
We offer nationwide coverage from our network of local offices in 40 markets across the U.S. and our centralized service center which is staffed 24/7.  
  
For 42 years, we have focused exclusively on recruiting safe, compliant drivers which has helped us maintain a perfect DOT audit record. In that time, we’ve built a leadership team that averages 19 years in the transportation industry and a staff with an average tenure of 6 years.  
  
The company has established a culture of reliability and respect that supports its customers and drivers so they can be efficient and profitable in their businesses and their jobs.

About Joao Sousapinto

Joao Sousapinto is a Staff Research Engineer at Apple’s Special Projects Group (SPG), where he plays a pivotal role in advancing motion planning for autonomous systems. His work sits at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and applied mathematics, making significant contributions to the development of intelligent systems capable of navigating complex environments. Leveraging his extensive expertise in algorithms, model predictive control, and optimization, Joao is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what autonomous systems can achieve.  
  
At Apple, Joao is currently involved in several key projects that focus on enhancing the efficiency and reliability of motion planning algorithms. His research emphasizes the integration of reinforcement learning techniques to improve decision-making processes in dynamic settings. By employing advanced control theory and optimal control strategies, he aims to create systems that can adapt to unforeseen circumstances while maintaining safety and performance.  
  
Joao's academic background, which includes a DPhil in Computer Science from the University of Oxford, has equipped him with a robust foundation in theoretical and practical aspects of robotics. His publication record, including notable contributions like the one found at \[arxiv.org/abs/2403.00748\](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.00748), showcases his commitment to advancing the field through rigorous research and innovative solutions. With a skill set that encompasses C++, Python, and various machine learning frameworks, Joao is well-positioned to tackle the challenges of autonomous systems, making him a valuable asset to the Apple SPG team and the broader robotics community.

What are the benefits of gel memory foam mattresses?

Gel memory foam mattresses offer several benefits, including enhanced support, pressure relief, and temperature regulation. The gel-infused foam conforms to your body shape, providing personalized comfort while helping to dissipate heat, keeping you cooler throughout the night. This makes them an excellent choice for those who tend to sleep hot or have specific support needs.

What should I consider when choosing a mattress?

When selecting a mattress, consider factors such as your preferred sleeping position (side, back, stomach), any specific health concerns (like back pain), the firmness level you prefer, and any materials you may be sensitive to. It's also important to consider the size of the mattress to ensure it fits your bed frame and room space.

Does Mattress Warehouse offer delivery services?

Yes, Mattress Warehouse provides delivery services for their products. The Louisville Sports Commission’s mission is to create a legacy of economic and social vitality through sports.  
  
The LSC annually helps attract, support, and host an average of 75 sports events that generate more than $50 million in economic benefits. These events and activities have a positive economic impact on Louisville, enhance the area’s image as a premier sports destination, promote active lifestyles, improve the quality of life for community members of all ages, and connect local businesses with student-athletes for future job opportunities.  
  
The LSC owns and operates the Paul Hornung Award; the Louisville Corporate Games; the Louisville Sports Commission Cross Country Classic, one of the largest cross country events in the US; the Derby City Cup cyclocross event; SportsFest; and a three-race fall running series comprised of the Urban Bourbon Half Marathon, the Norton Sports Health Great Pumpkin 10K, and the Louisville pure tap® 5K.

About Sint-Trudo Ziekenhuis
---------------------------

Sint-Trudo Ziekenhuis is een dynamisch, modern en volledig vernieuwd ziekenhuis met 310 erkende bedden, ruim 850 medewerkers en een 150-tal artsen. Wij focussen op een patiëntgericht, preventief en kwalitatief gezondheidsbeleid. We zijn deskundig én dichtbij en staan elke dag klaar voor mekaar en voor onze patiënten.  
  
Sint-Trudo Ziekenhuis is een moderne zorginstelling die, naast lid van het ziekenhuisnetwerk Andreaz, ook samenwerkt met andere ziekenhuizen en partners binnen een transmurale zorgketen. Sint-Trudo focust zich op gespecialiseerde basiszorg en differentieert zich daarnaast ook in bepaalde subspecialismen.  
  
De laatste jaren bouwt Sint-Trudo samen met LIGB-KU Leuven verder aan een nog meer duurzaam kwaliteitsbeleid door een pioniersrol op te nemen in de ontwikkeling van het Vlaamse kwaliteitsmodel “FlaQuM”. Sint-Trudo financiert één van de drie leerstoelen om deze ontwikkeling en implementatie mogelijk te maken.  
  
We zijn een ziekenhuis met een gezonde dosis ambitie, we willen vooruit. Sint-Trudo bouwt continu verder aan de toekomst met grote en minder grote projecten en innovaties. Zo willen we onze maatschappelijke rol ook in de toekomst optimaal blijven vervullen.  
  
De beste zorg bieden en onze ambities waarmaken, kunnen we uiteraard niet zonder onze medewerkers. Zij zijn de drijvende kracht van ons ziekenhuis en zijn van zeer grote waarde voor ons ziekenhuis en onze patiënten. Daarom zetten we alles op alles om onze medewerkers werkgeluk te bieden.

What services does the Western Conservation Foundation offer?

The Western Conservation Foundation provides a range of services focused on environmental conservation and sustainable resource management. These services include habitat restoration, conservation planning, community engagement, and educational programs aimed at promoting awareness of conservation issues. The foundation works collaboratively with local communities, government agencies, and other organizations to implement effective conservation strategies.

Which industries does the Western Conservation Foundation support?

The Western Conservation Foundation supports various industries, including agriculture, forestry, water management, and renewable energy. By promoting sustainable practices within these sectors, the foundation aims to balance economic development with environmental stewardship. Their initiatives often involve working with industry stakeholders to develop best practices that minimize ecological impact while maximizing resource efficiency.

How can I get involved with the Western Conservation Foundation?

There are several ways to get involved with the Western Conservation Foundation. Individuals can participate in volunteer opportunities, attend educational workshops, or contribute to conservation projects. Additionally, donations are always welcome to support ongoing initiatives. For more information on how to get involved, you can visit the foundation's website or contact their outreach team directly.

Does the Western Conservation Foundation offer educational programs?

Yes, the Western Conservation Foundation offers a variety of educational programs aimed at raising awareness about conservation issues and promoting sustainable practices. These programs are designed for different audiences, including schools, community groups, and industry professionals. Workshops, seminars, and hands-on activities are part of the curriculum to engage participants and foster a deeper understanding of environmental conservation.

What types of habitat restoration projects does the Western Conservation Foundation undertake?

The Western Conservation Foundation undertakes a wide range of habitat restoration projects, including wetland restoration, reforestation, and the rehabilitation of degraded landscapes. These projects are tailored to the specific ecological needs of the area and often involve collaboration with local communities and stakeholders. The foundation focuses on restoring native ecosystems to enhance biodiversity and improve the resilience of natural habitats.

How does the Western Conservation Foundation measure the success of its conservation efforts?

The Western Conservation Foundation employs various metrics to measure the success of its conservation efforts. These include ecological assessments, biodiversity surveys, and community feedback. The foundation conducts regular monitoring and evaluation of its projects to assess their impact on the environment and local communities. By analyzing data and outcomes, the foundation can adapt its strategies to ensure continuous improvement and effectiveness in achieving conservation goals.

About Ford's Theatre Society
----------------------------

One of the most visited sites in the nation’s capital, Ford’s Theatre reopened its doors in 1968, more than a hundred years after the assassination of President Abraham Lincoln. Operated through a partnership between Ford’s Theatre Society and the National Park Service, Ford’s Theatre is the premier destination in the nation’s capital to explore and celebrate Abraham Lincoln’s ideals and leadership principles: courage, integrity, equality and creative expression.  
  
The mission of Ford’s Theatre Society is to celebrate the legacy of Abraham Lincoln and explore the American experience through theatre and education. Since the arrival of Director Paul R. Tetreault, critics and the theatregoing public have recognized Ford’s for the superior quality of its artistic programming, with works from the Tony-nominated "Come From Away" and nationally acclaimed "Big River " to the world premieres of "Meet John Doe," "The Heavens Are Hung In Black," "Liberty Smith," "Necessary Sacrifices," "The Widow Lincoln" and "The Guard." For its accomplishments, the organization was honored in 2008 with the National Medal of Arts.  
  
In the past decade, the mission of Ford’s Theatre Society expanded to include education as a central pillar. This expansion led to the creation and construction of the Center for Education and Leadership, which opened in February 2012. Currently, under the leadership of Board of Trustees Chairman Eric A. Spiegel, the Society is building Ford’s Theatre into a national destination for exploring Lincoln’s ideas and leadership principles and finding new ways to bring Lincoln’s legacy to life for the 21st-century learner. For more information, visit www.fords.org.

About Zeta Specialist Lighting Ltd
----------------------------------

Part of the Zeta Group, Zeta Specialist Lighting is a UK-based developer and manufacturer of LED and solar powered lighting systems. The company designs, develops and manufactures intelligent, robust and reliable engineered products suited to a wide range of applications. From LED solutions that lower energy bills and carbon emissions for customers across the world, including custom luminaires for street lighting, amenity lighting, signage and LED commercial lighting solutions; to the design and manufacture of complete solar lighting solutions.  
Here at Zeta Specialist Lighting we pride ourselves in working with customers to design, manufacture and deliver innovative products that meet their specification at a competitive price. Customers include Transport for London, Wasabi, Mercedes Benz and Eurosigns, as well as a number of local authorities and educational establishments.  
Zeta Specialist Lighting has earned an excellent reputation for high quality, innovative products and has been awarded several awards for research and technology; no less than 5 DTI SMART Awards recognise the innovation that lies central to its success, along with a number of business and individual product awards.  
Zeta Specialist Lighting is an ISO9001 certified company.

About Henry Jackman

Henry Jackman is a renowned English composer known for his work in film, television, and video games. With a career spanning over two decades, Jackman has established himself as a leading figure in the world of music composition, collaborating with some of the most talented filmmakers and artists in the industry.  
  
Born in Hillingdon, Middlesex, England, Jackman developed his passion for music at a young age. He attended St. Paul's School in London, where he began studying classical music and honing his skills as a pianist. After completing his education, Jackman went on to further his musical studies at the Trinity College of Music, where he received a degree in classical music composition.  
  
Upon graduating, Jackman began his career as a music producer, working on various projects in the music industry. However, it was not long before he found his true calling in the world of film scoring. His early work in the industry included collaborating with acclaimed composer Hans Zimmer, who took notice of Jackman's talent and helped him secure his first major film scoring opportunity.  
  
One of Jackman's most notable early works was his collaboration with Zimmer on the hit superhero film "The Dark Knight." His contributions to the film's score were met with widespread acclaim, earning him recognition as a rising star in the world of film composition. This success paved the way for Jackman to take on more high-profile projects, solidifying his reputation as a versatile and innovative composer.  
  
Throughout his career, Jackman has demonstrated a remarkable ability to adapt his musical style to suit the unique demands of each project. His diverse body of work spans across various genres, from action-packed blockbusters to heartfelt dramas, showcasing his versatility as a composer. Whether it be crafting an intense, adrenaline-pumping score for a superhero film or delivering a poignant, emotive composition for a dramatic feature, Jackman has consistently demonstrated his talent for creating music that enhances the visual storytelling of the projects he works on.  
  
In addition to his work in film, Jackman has also made significant contributions to the world of television and video game scoring. His music has been featured in popular television series such as "Black Mirror" and "Big Love," further showcasing his ability to create compelling and evocative compositions across different mediums. Furthermore, Jackman's work in the realm of video game scoring has earned him recognition for his ability to create immersive and dynamic soundscapes that enhance the gaming experience for players.  
  
One of Jackman's most notable recent works is his collaboration with the Marvel Cinematic Universe, for which he has scored several films including "Captain America: The Winter Soldier," "Captain America: Civil War," and "Wreck-It Ralph." His contributions to these films have been praised for their ability to capture the essence of the characters and elevate the cinematic experience for audiences. His work on "Captain America: Civil War" in particular earned him widespread acclaim, with many citing the film's score as a standout element that enhanced its emotional depth and intensity.  
  
Jackman's exceptional talent as a composer has not gone unnoticed within the industry, as he has received several award nominations for his work, including a Grammy nomination for his score for the film "Captain Phillips." His ability to infuse his music with emotion, drama, and energy has made him a sought-after collaborator for filmmakers seeking to bring their stories to life through music.  
  
In addition to his work in the entertainment industry, Jackman is also passionate about giving back to the next generation of composers and musicians. He has been involved in mentoring and supporting emerging talent, sharing his knowledge and expertise with aspiring artists and helping them navigate the complexities of the industry.  
  
Henry Jackman's impact on the world of music composition is undeniable. His ability to create evocative and memorable scores has elevated the storytelling of countless films, television series, and video games, leaving a lasting impression on audiences around the world. With his continued dedication to his craft and his innovative approach to composition, Jackman is poised to remain a leading figure in the world of music for years to come.

About Monnalisa S.p.A
---------------------

“The Company supports its employees throughout their working lives, listening to their needs, while promoting their skills and personal growth”  
  
Monnalisa SpA (Ticker MNL), listed on the Euronext Growth Milan market since July 12, 2018 and engaged in the high-end childrenswear segment, reported 2021 revenues of over Euro 43.6 million. Founded in Arezzo in 1968, it has a presence in more than 60 countries, both through directly owned boutiques and at the world's top department stores and more than 500 multibrand outlets. Focusing on high-quality and “Made in Italy” style, its research and development investment is matched by a commitment to sustainability. Monnalisa complies with the SA8000 regulation and environmental certification ISO 14001. Confirming its ongoing ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) development, the company was awarded the Standard Ethics’ EE- (adequate) rating, positioning itself at the top of the sector.  
  
Monnalisa's mission is to build both values and value over time, through quality products with a strong identity, a flexible and customised service, a dynamic work environment, a fruitful and continuous relationship with suppliers, and a sustainable business for the region - with the objective of excelling in innovation, creativity, promoting managerial expertise, expanding production and commercial operations globally, while always maintaining the company's core values and identity.  
  
  
Diversity and inclusion are two pillars of Monnalisa's Human Resources management - with an 82% female workforce, work-life balance has always been a Company core commitment, thanks to which Monnalisa has been recognized from the SME Welfare Index in the years 2017, 2018 and 2020 with the "women's mention" award for its focus on welfare.  
  
Human capital has always been at the centre of Monnalisa's policies, through a strong focus on skills, training and talent development paths, and the promotion of family support and work/life balance initiatives.

His background in technical writing and conference organization enhances his ability to communicate effectively and lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and innovation within the organization.  
  
Mike's experience extends beyond the nonprofit sector, with a unique skill set that includes nuclear decommissioning and government relations, which provides him with a multifaceted perspective on leadership and community service. His commitment to developing leaders and nurturing discipleship is evident in his strategic approach to ministry, making him a vital asset to The Navigators and the communities he serves. About Ruiqi Zhang

Ruiqi Zhang serves as an Executive Director in Quant Modeling at JPMorgan Chase & Co., where he plays a pivotal role in shaping the bank's approach to Wholesale Credit Risk management. With over a decade of experience in risk modeling and macroeconomic forecasting, Ruiqi leads the Wholesale Credit Risk model review and governance team, focusing on critical areas such as Commercial Real Estate (CRE/CMBS) and the Fair Value Option (FVO). His expertise is particularly valuable in the context of regulatory frameworks, including Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) stress testing, Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) methodologies, and Basel III capital requirements.  
  
Ruiqi's academic foundation, with a Ph.D. in Statistics and a B.S. in Mathematics, underpins his advanced proficiency in quantitative analysis and statistical modeling. He adeptly employs both traditional statistical techniques and innovative methodologies to enhance the robustness of risk assessments. His team is responsible for ensuring that the models used for stress testing and regulatory capital calculations are not only compliant with regulatory guidance but also reflective of the evolving economic landscape.  
  
In addition to his technical skills in R, SAS programming, and various statistical analysis tools, Ruiqi is known for his strategic vision in credit risk management. He leverages his in-depth understanding of multivariate statistics, time series analysis, and survival analysis to derive insights that inform decision-making at the highest levels of the organization. Ruiqi's commitment to excellence and his collaborative approach make him a key contributor to JPMorgan Chase's mission of maintaining a resilient and forward-looking risk management framework.

About Prime Advantage
---------------------

Prime Advantage is a buying group, delivering total cost reduction to members through group volume discounts and rebates, networking, education, benchmarking, and sharing best practices. Members of Prime Advantage benefit by reducing their overall costs, partnering with top performing suppliers, and reducing supply chain risk. Endorsed Suppliers of the company benefit by increased market share and decreased sales cycle time. Its main goal is to make mid-sized manufacturing companies more competitive from a cost standpoint. Prime Advantage is a Group Purchasing Organization for industrial manufacturing and food processing firms, dedicated to bringing its clients the best possible savings on raw materials, components, supplies, and services. By combining the purchasing power of mid-sized firms, it uses its group power to negotiate volume rebates and discounts with an exclusive group of Endorsed Suppliers. Prime Advantage was founded in 1997 by \[Louise O'Sullivan\](http://www.crunchbase.com/person/louise-o-sull...

99% of marketers will never set aside time weekly to learn something new each week.

Now imagine being part of a peer group that helps you consistently connect, intentionally learn, and professionally grow, to be in a leadership role, and do the best work of your life.  
  
Because we believe without a community, you are simply a commodity.  
  
Peak Community is an invite-only community specifically designed for marketers who want to learn and grow consistently, 1% better each week.  
  
Who should be part of this: Practitioners who want to learn to be a better , land a big promotion, and will commit at least 30 mins each week to ask questions, engage, and learn to make themselves better. In short, the 1%.  
  
Who should NOT be part of this: Lurkers and if you want to sell, promote your product or yourself, or cannot spend at least 30 mins to engage and grow yourself and the community. In short, the 99%.  
  
We want to be the most engaged community. Not the largest.

About ADSB
----------

The establishment of Abu Dhabi Ship Building (ADSB) was in line with the vision of H.H. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed (Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Deputy Supreme Commander of the UAE Armed Forces) to have a world-class facility in Abu Dhabi to support the UAE Navy. Inaugurated in 1996, ADSB initially focused on naval repairs and refits and gradually expanded its expertise to include building sophisticated war ships like the Baynunah 70m Corvette.  
  
ADSB now specialises in the construction, repair and refit of Naval, Military and Commercial vessels. The company boasts an impressive portfolio of build and refit projects that are collectively worth at least AED 4 billion. Moreover, the company is widely recognised for carrying out its projects in Steel, Aluminium Alloy and High Tech Composite Materials according to the most stringent international standards.  
  
Leveraging its highly strategic, centralised location in the Arabian Gulf region, ADSB is rapidly consolidating its position as the leading ship builder and support contractor for all Naval, Military and Commercial operators in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC).  
  
ADSB has also built a global network of strategic partners from different countries, each offering a unique set of professional and technical expertise that complement ADSB's specialised maritime capabilities. ADSB's strategic partners have been carefully selected for their expertise, specialist knowledge and reputation in the design and build of Naval, Military and Commercial Ships.  
  
As a UAE Public Joint Stock Company, ADSB is proud to serve and support the UAE and the rest of the GCC's military and commercial marine organisations and operators.  
  
Proud To Serve - Abu Dhabi Ship Building, a UAE Public Joint Stock Company, is proud to be of service and support to the Gulf Cooperation Council's military and commercial marine organizations and operators.

About Ministerie van Justitie
-----------------------------

Een samenleving waarin iedereen veilig is. Waar je rechten worden gerespecteerd en beschermd – los van je opvattingen of levensstijl. Een samenleving waar we meningsverschillen en ruzies op een rechtvaardige en daadkrachtige manier oplossen. Waar we mensen die de wet overtreden opsporen, vervolgen, berechten en bestraffen volgens duidelijke regels. Een samenleving waar je je als slachtoffer beschermd voelt, en waar je goede opvang en begeleiding krijgt. Waar ook anderen bescherming kunnen vinden wanneer die in hun land van herkomst ontbreekt. Voor die samenleving maken wij als ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (JenV) ons iedere dag sterk. Beleid én praktijk, samen met onze partners  
  
De Rijksoverheid zorgt voor effectief beleid en goede wet- en regelgeving. Met duizenden bevlogen collega’s in heel Nederland passen we die vervolgens in de praktijk toe bij de vele onderdelen en diensten van JenV. Denk maar aan de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (de gevangenissen) of de Immigratie-en Naturalisatiedienst.  
  
Naast onze collega’s werken talrijke mensen bij andere overheden, bedrijven en instellingen zij aan zij met ons aan een rechtvaardig en veilig Nederland. Dat is ook nodig; alleen mét elkaar lossen we de ingewikkelde vraagstukken op waarvoor we dagelijks komen te staan.  
  
We zijn in ons werk steeds op zoek naar balans. Bijvoorbeeld tussen de rechten van slachtoffers en verdachten, of tussen veiligheid en privacy. Dat zijn lastige afwegingen, en we laten als dat kan graag zien waarom we bepaalde keuzes maken. Wat komt er bijvoorbeeld allemaal kijken bij de beslissing op een asielverzoek? Hoe stelt een onderzoeker van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming vast wat er aan de hand is in een gezin?  
  
We werken hard aan een veilig, rechtvaardig Nederland. Met resultaat: ons land staat de afgelopen jaren steeds in de top 10 van Europese en wereldwijde onafhankelijke onderzoeken naar indicatoren van een goed functionerende, veilige rechtsstaat.

About Troy Fohrman

Troy Fohrman is a seasoned consultant at Paradox Private Equity Funds, LLC, where he leverages over 29 years of extensive experience in sales, operations, training, and marketing to drive innovative solutions in the healthcare sector. His current focus on electrochromic and electrophoretic polymer surface coating solutions positions him at the forefront of advanced technology applications, particularly in clinical research and healthcare. Troy's expertise in data-generating surface coatings is pivotal for enhancing healthcare applications, enabling the capture and analysis of clinical research datasets from both structured and unstructured electronic medical record systems (EMR/EHR).  
  
At Paradox, Troy is instrumental in developing strategic initiatives that bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and market needs. His work in Real World Evidence (RWE) is particularly noteworthy, as it allows for a deeper understanding of patient outcomes and treatment efficacy through data analytics. By integrating advanced polymer-based solutions into healthcare practices, he is not only driving demand generation but also fostering partnerships with channel partners across various specialties, including immunology, neurology, dermatology, and infectious diseases.  
  
Troy’s exceptional organizational, negotiation, and communication skills have earned him recognition as a key contributor to numerous successful product launches and sales enablement programs. His ability to navigate complex market dynamics and align innovative solutions with the needs of SMBs to Fortune 100 companies underscores his commitment to integrity and excellence in the healthcare industry. As he continues to shape the future of healthcare technology, Troy remains dedicated to empowering organizations with the insights and tools necessary to thrive in an increasingly data-driven landscape.
